★ B review_note: 已核对 RFC 3521-3523 行：'C->W: GET /twister.sdp HTTP/1.1 / Host: www.example.com / Accept: application/sdp'，锚点 3522 一致。该行是 §14.1 示例 HTTP 报文里的头字段取值，属示例文本，不是 'Host 头字段应为/不应为何值' 的规范条款；候选字段全空。故判 rejection。

★ A 字段（供字段级仲裁）.subject: UAS（用户代理服务器）
★ A 字段（供字段级仲裁）.object: 请求中全部 Record-Route 头域值（含 URI、URI 参数与头域参数），并保持其顺序
★ A 字段（供字段级仲裁）.condition: 当 UAS 以建立 dialog 的响应（如对 INVITE 的 2xx）应答请求时

★ B 字段（供字段级仲裁）.subject: UAS
★ B 字段（供字段级仲裁）.object: all Record-Route header field values from the request into the response
★ B 字段（供字段级仲裁）.condition: when a UAS responds to a request with a response that establishes a dialog (such as a 2xx to INVITE)

★ A review_note: 3907–3912 行「When a UAS responds to a request with a response that establishes a dialog (such as a 2xx to INVITE), the UAS MUST copy all Record-Route header field values from the request into the response (including the URIs, URI parameters, and any Record-Route header field parameters…) and MUST maintain the order of those values.」义务成立。缺陷：候选漏填 condition；同段另有两项 MUST（3911–3912 行保持顺序、3912 行「The UAS MUST add a Contact header field to the response」）未被覆盖。
★ B review_note: 已核对 RFC 3907-3911 行：'When a UAS responds to a request with a response that establishes a dialog (such as a 2xx to INVITE), the UAS MUST copy all Record-Route header field values from the request into the response (including the URIs, URI parameters, and any Record-Route header field parameters, whether they are known or unknown to the UAS) and MUST maintain the order of those values.'，锚点 3908 一致。义务真实；但候选漏填条件从句 'When a UAS responds ... establishes a dialog'，且未涵盖同句第二个 MUST（maintain the order），故记 partially_supported。

★ A review_note: 1866–1868 行「The Content-Length header field value is used to locate the end of each SIP message in a stream. It will always be present when SIP messages are sent over stream-oriented transports.」是头字段用途的说明性描述，无规范强度；候选六字段全空。注：同一上下文 1862–1864 行确有真实 MUST（「Implementations processing SIP messages over stream-oriented transports MUST ignore any CRLF before the start-line」），但该候选声称的是 Content-Length 用途，不是这条 MUST，且锚点 1864 恰落在该句末尾属跨度偏移。
★ B review_note: 已核对 RFC 1862-1868 行：锚点 1864 行 '[H4.1].' 是 1862-1864 行 'Implementations processing SIP messages over stream-oriented transports MUST ignore any CRLF appearing before the start-line [H4.1].' 的末行；但候选 entity/meaning 指向 1866-1868 行 'The Content-Length header field value is used to locate the end of each SIP message in a stream. It will always be present when SIP messages are sent over stream-oriented transports.'，该句是描述性断言（'It will always be present'），无规范强度，候选 subject/action/object/strength 全空。故对候选所声称内容判 rejection。
